title: Product data for Junction 2026 Valio Aimo challenge. While inspired by real-world, this dataset does not contain fully accurate product information and it must not be used for anything outside of Junction 2026 event

allowedLotSize.description: Smallest quantity step the product can be ordered in (order quantity must be a multiple of it), in sales units.

baseUnit.description: Base unit of measure of the product. Unit codes such as KI are technical codes and their translations are not included in this data set.

category.description: Product category code. Category names are not part of this data set.

countryOfOrigin.description: Country of origin as a lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example fi or de.

deleted.description: True if the product has been deleted. Products are only included in this file if they are not deleted, so the value is always false.

deposits.description: Deposit (returnable packaging) items that are charged together with the product.

material.description: Product code of the deposit material.

quantity.description: Number of deposit units charged per sales unit of the product.

unit.description: Unit of the deposit quantity, for example ST (piece). Unit codes such as KI are technical codes and their translations are not included in this data set.

id.description: Product code. Use it as the product id in the API requests and in the other data files.

salesUnit.description: Unit of measure the product is sold in. Unit codes such as KI are technical codes and their translations are not included in this data set.

salesUnitGtin.description: GTIN (barcode number) of the sales unit. Not all products have one

substitutions.description: Products that can replace this product when it is not available.

product.description: Product code of the product being substituted.

substituteProduct.description: Product code of the product that can be offered instead.

synkkaData.description: Product information supplied by the manufacturer through the GS1 Synkka product data service. Quantity and quality vary between products, so most fields can be missing.

classifications.description: Classifications of the product, grouped by name: nutrition values, allergens, labels, claims and packaging.

name.description: Name of the group, for example allergen, nonAllergen, nutritionFact, gda, nutritionalClaim, packaging or packagingMarkedLabel.

type.description: Type of the values in the group: ENUM for codes or DECIMAL for numbers.

unit.description: Unit of the value, for example GRM (gram) or KJO (kilojoule). For allergens it tells how the allergen relates to the product: CONTAINS or FREE_FROM.

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

countriesOfOrigin.description: Countries of origin as numeric ISO 3166-1 codes, for example 246 for Finland.

disposalInformations.description: Instructions for recycling or disposing of the packaging in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

catchMethods.description: How and where the fish was produced.

areas.description: Codes of the fishing areas, for example 27. Names are not part of this data set

methods.description: Codes of the fishing method, for example TM or 03. Names are not part of this dataset.

productionMethod.description: Production method: AQUACULTURE, MARINE_FISHERY or INLAND_FISHERY.

id.description: Species code, for example SAL (salmon) or HER (herring).

gtin.description: GTIN (barcode number) of the consumer unit.

ingredients.description: Ingredients in structured form, in order of the ingredient list.

names.description: Name of the ingredient in several languages.

language.description: Language of the name as an ISO 639-1 code.

origins.description: Where the ingredient comes from, by production stage.

country.description: Country of the origin as a numeric ISO 3166-1 code, or NON_EU.

type.description: Production stage the origin refers to, for example FARMING, MILKING, REARING, BIRTH or LAST_PROCESSING.

percentage.description: Share of the ingredient in the product, in percent.

sequence.description: Position of the ingredient in the ingredient list, starting from 1.

keyIngredients.descrption: Ingredient statement or main ingredients of the product in different languages

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

lastUpdated.description: Time the product information was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

marketingTexts.description: Marketing description of the product in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

materialAdditionalDescriptions.description: Additional description of the product, for example the contents of a multipack in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

maxTemperature.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius.

medias.description: Images and other media of the product. The files themselves are not part of this data set.

primary.description: True for the main image of the product.

mediasLastUpdated.description: Time the images and other media were last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

minTemperature.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

basisQuantity.description: Quantity the value is given for, for example 100.

basisQuantityUnit.description: Unit of the basis quantity, for example GRM (gram) or MLT (millilitre).

dailyValueIntakePercent.description: Share of the recommended daily intake that the value covers, in percent.

id.description: Nutrient code, for example ENER-KJO (energy, kJ), ENER-E14 (energy, kcal), FAT, FASAT (saturated fat), CHOAVL (carbohydrate), SUGAR- (sugars), FIBTG (fibre), PRO- (protein) or SALTEQ (salt).

servingSizeUnit.description: Unit of the serving size, GRM or MLT.

unit.description: Unit of the value, for example GRM (gram), MGM (milligram), KJO (kilojoule) or E14 (kilocalorie).

unitPrecision.description: How exact the value is, for example APPROXIMATELY, LESS_THAN or ABOUT.

value.description: Amount of the nutrient, in the unit given, per basisQuantity.

preparationInstructions.description: Instructions for preparing the product in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

id.description: Identifier of the producer, a 13-digit location number.

sheetId.description: Identifier or date of the safety data sheet.

values.description: Hazard and precautionary statements of the sheet.

id.description: Statement code, for example h319 or p280. Descriptions of the codes are not in this dataset

storageInstructions.description: Instructions for storing the product in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

unitConversions.description: Weights and dimensions of each packaging level of the product.

grossWeight.description: Gross weight, including packaging of the packaging level.

unit.description: Unit of the value: GRM (gram) or KGM (kilogram).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

unit.description: Unit of the value: MMT (millimetre) or CMT (centimetre).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

unit.description: Unit of the value: MMT (millimetre) or CMT (centimetre).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

netWeight.description: Net weight of the contents of the packaging level.

unit.description: Unit of the value: GRM (gram) or KGM (kilogram).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

synkkaPackagingType.description: Packaging level: BASE_UNIT_OR_EACH (consumer unit), CASE or PALLET.

unit.description: Unit of the value: for example LTR (litre) or MLT (millilitre).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

unit.description: Unit of the value: MMT (millimetre) or CMT (centimetre).

value.description: Numeric value, in the unit given.

usageInstructions.description: Instructions for using the product in several languages.

language.description: Language of the text as an ISO 639-1 code, for example fi, sv or en.

variableUnit.description: True if the product is sold by variable weight, so that the actual quantity of a unit varies.

vatCode.description: VAT class of the product in Finland: STANDARD (25.5 %), MEDIUM (reduced rate for food, 13.5 %) or LOW (reduced rate, 10 %). The official source of truth is tax.taxRate of the price API.

temperatureCondition.description: Code of the temperature (storage and transport) class of the product, e.g. ambient, chilled or frozen. Code meanings are not part of this data set.

units.description: Packaging hierarchy of the product: the units it can be handled in, each with its own barcode.

sizeInBaseUnits.description: How many base units the unit contains.

unitId.description: Code of the unit. Unit codes such as KI are technical codes and their translations are not included in this data set.

vendorName.description: Name of the vendor (supplier) of the product.
